cohort: The study included 153,469 live births in the state of Parana, Brazil in 2019.
finding: Independent factors associated with cesarean births without clinical indication included maternal age >=35 years, having a partner, previous miscarriage, hospital delivery, absence of previous normal delivery, and paternal age >=30 years.
mod_finding: There was a significant prevalence of cesarean births without clinical indication in Parana, particularly in Robson Groups 1 to 5, accounting for 74.6% of all cesarean deliveries.
